Exampleland Rules of Family Procedure

Rule 7. Case management.

(a) In a contested family matter the court may enter a case-management order that sets communication and disclosure requirements for the parties.

(b) A case-management order may be modified on motion or on the court's own initiative.

Rules current as of July 1, 2026.
